subject.title: [Bug]: Signal DM silently dropped on reply session initialization conflict (retry fix ported to Slack/Telegram but not Signal)

question: Which open fix path should own the Signal message-loss issue before this issue is closed?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but two Signal-local PRs and a broader session recovery PR overlap the same conflict family, so a maintainer should pick the canonical implementation before landing divergent retry behavior.

options.title: Choose A Signal-Local Retry PR
options.body: Review and land the cleaner Signal debounce retry candidate after live Signal proof confirms conflicted DMs are preserved without duplication.

options.title: Consolidate On Shared Recovery
options.body: Use the broader reply-session recovery PR if maintainers confirm it covers the Signal drop path, then close the Signal-local retry PRs as superseded.

options.title: Keep All Candidates Pending
options.body: Leave the issue and all candidate PRs open until stronger live proof or maintainer ownership makes the canonical path clear.

recommendation.title: Choose A Signal-Local Retry PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the cleaner Signal debounce retry candidate after live Signal proof confirms conflicted DMs are preserved without duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest sibling retry history among the likely owners and is a reasonable routing point for deciding the canonical retry shape.
